_doc: The one catalogue of API error codes (every route, not only auth). Every error body is {"error": code, "message": English sentence}. throttle-responses.json holds worked examples of the sign-in throttling subset; each of its codes and statuses must appear here with the same status.

bad_request.meaning: Malformed or incomplete request: a body that is not the JSON the route reads, or a query parameter or form field that is missing or not in its format; the message names it. The AI routes answer it with 422 when the provider refused the request.

unauthorized.meaning: No session, or the token is unknown, idle for 90 days or revoked, or the access token is unknown, expired or revoked. The client drops its token and shows sign-in.

bad_credentials.meaning: Wrong username or password at sign-in (anonymous step, not a lost session).

registration_closed.meaning: Registration is closed: only an administrator creates accounts (the instance already has users and the mode is closed).

invite_invalid.meaning: The invite link is unknown, expired, used up or revoked (one code and one body for all four, so a guesser learns nothing).

email_required.meaning: The email policy is required and no address was sent.

email_disabled.meaning: The email policy is off and an address was sent.

invalid_email.meaning: Not a usable email address (one @, a dotted domain, at most 254 bytes).

email_taken.meaning: Another account already uses that email address (compared case-insensitively).

mail_unavailable.meaning: The setting needs a working mail server and none is configured.

invalid_language.meaning: A language code that is not well formed: a workspace or admin language that is not like es or pt-br, or an interface language that is neither empty (follow the browser) nor a language tag in canonical case (language, optional script, optional region: en, zh-Hant, pt-BR; see i18n/language-tags.json). Syntax only: an unsupported but well-formed tag is stored.

invalid_host.meaning: The mail server host name is empty, too long, or has a scheme, path or space.

smtp_host_blocked.meaning: The mail server address is never allowed (metadata, link-local) or private and QINQIN_SMTP_ALLOW_PRIVATE is off.

invalid_port.meaning: The mail server port is outside 1-65535.

invalid_tls.meaning: The connection security is not starttls, tls or none.

credentials_need_tls.meaning: A user name was given with connection security none: credentials never travel in clear text.

invalid_public_url.meaning: The public URL is not an absolute http(s) address without path, query, fragment or login.

password_reentry_required.meaning: The server, port, security, user name or public URL changed (or the stored password cannot be read): the mail password must be sent again.

recipient_required.meaning: A test mail needs a recipient and the account has no email address.

secret_unavailable.meaning: QINQIN_SECRET is missing or invalid, so a secret (mail password, two-factor secret) cannot be stored.

smtp_test_failed.meaning: The test mail failed. The body carries category (connect, blocked, tls, auth, sender, recipient, timeout, protocol) and smtpCode when the server gave a reply code; never the server's text.

code_invalid.meaning: A one-time code (email code, authenticator code, recovery code) is wrong. The emailed-code and sign-in second steps carry attemptsLeft; the re-authentication checks before an account or administrator action do not (their budget is per user). 403 on routes with a session, 401 on the anonymous sign-in steps (login/mfa, email-login/verify), so the client never mistakes it for a lost session.

challenge_expired.meaning: The code challenge is gone: expired (10 minutes), spent, or tried 5 times. Start again (401 on the anonymous sign-in steps, 403 with a session).

nothing_to_verify.meaning: Resend asked for a code but the account has no unverified email address.

setup_expired.meaning: The authenticator setup (10 minutes) expired before its first code was confirmed. Start the setup again.

not_enabled.meaning: The method the request changes is not on (disable or regenerate without an authenticator).

email_unverified.meaning: The email method needs a verified address: confirm it first.

mfa_required.meaning: On an account route: turning this method off would leave the account without a second step while the administrator requires one. (On the sign-in route the same code is a 200 status word, see login-responses.json.)

method_unavailable.meaning: The second-step method asked for (an emailed code) is not available for this account or instance.

email_login_unavailable.meaning: Sign-in by emailed code is switched off (or the server has no mail): use the password.

password_login_required.meaning: Two-step sign-in is required and this account has no authenticator, so an emailed code alone cannot sign in: use the password.

mail_outage.meaning: Sign-in refused (fail closed): the account's second step is an emailed code and the server cannot send mail. Retry later; an administrator can fix Admin, Email or run qinqin recover --reset-mfa.

last_admin.meaning: The change would leave the instance without an active administrator.

self_target.meaning: An administrator tried to disable or delete their own account, or reset their own two-step sign-in, through the admin routes (Settings, Account does these).

invalid_request.meaning: A well-formed request the server will not do (for example cancelling a forced password change), or a value out of its range (a label too long, an unknown highlight colour); the message names the field.

token_invalid.meaning: A reset link is unknown, expired, already used or belongs to a disabled account (one code and one body for all of them).

confirm_mismatch.meaning: The typed confirmation (the username) does not match the account being deleted.

password_required.meaning: An administrator action that needs the acting administrator's own password (the list on the wiki page Admin-users-and-registration, Re-authentication: e.g. grant admin, delete another user, change an address, save the mail settings, lower a sign-in protection) came without currentPassword. An administrator with an authenticator also sends code (403 code_invalid). On PUT /api/admin/settings/smtp the same code can also mean the mail account's user name needs a password; the message says which.

invalid_invite.meaning: An invite parameter is out of range (uses 1-100, expiry 1-90 days, note at most 100 characters).

invalid_setting.meaning: A settings value outside its vocabulary.

account_disabled.meaning: Right password, but an administrator disabled the account.

password_change_required.meaning: The session must choose a new password before anything else; the token stays valid.

mfa_enrollment_required.meaning: The session must enrol a second factor before anything else; the token stays valid.

wrong_password.meaning: The re-entered current password is wrong. 403, never 401, so the client keeps its token.

current_password_required.meaning: The current password was not sent but this session must give it (everything except the session born from the temporary-password login). Refused before any attempt is counted; show the field.

export_running.meaning: An export of the user's data is already streaming (backup contract). Try again when it has finished.

restore_running.meaning: A restore of the user's data is running (or an export is refused because one is). Poll the stage; nothing can be started beside it.

backup_running.meaning: An administrator's whole-server backup is already running; one at a time.

stage_not_ready.meaning: The uploaded backup is still being checked, was refused or was already used; apply only when the status is ready.

unresolved_entries.meaning: The backup refers to words this server does not have; send "unresolved": "drop" to restore without them (the report lists them first).

unsupported_media_type.meaning: The restore upload must be sent as application/zip.

backup_too_large.meaning: A backup upload above 128 MiB, or an archive beyond the entry, line or expanded-size caps (also a stage error code).

restore_busy.meaning: Another restore is being applied on this server (only one at a time; a restore holds the database write lock about 30 s per million events). Retry-After is 30; try again later.

backup_too_many_events.meaning: Stage error code: the backup holds more than 2,000,000 study events, which a restore refuses.

backup_invalid.meaning: Stage error code, not an HTTP status: the uploaded file is not a valid qinqin backup (hostile or damaged zip, bad checksum, unknown field) or cannot be restored here (language not set up). status carries the stage, the HTTP answer of the status route is 200.

backup_version_unsupported.meaning: Stage error code: the archive's formatVersion is not one this server reads (formats are never guessed).

backup_too_large_to_restore.meaning: Export refused: the archive would exceed what a restore accepts (128 MiB compressed, 2 GiB expanded, 64 MiB per book), so no download link is issued.

insufficient_storage.meaning: Admin server backup: the data volume lacks room for a snapshot of the database (database + WAL + 64 MiB).

not_found.meaning: No such object (or it belongs to someone else), or no such API path.

too_large.meaning: Request body above the route's cap.

weak_password.meaning: The new password breaks the policy (10-256 characters, not the username). message names the rule.

invalid_username.meaning: The username breaks the policy (3-32 letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; no @). message names the rule.

rate_limited.meaning: Too many attempts; Retry-After carries the wait in whole seconds. Never retry automatically. On the AI routes: the hourly AI call limit is used up.

internal.meaning: Unexpected server error; nothing was changed.

busy.meaning: The password-hash gate is saturated; Retry-After is 2. Never retry automatically. On the AI and journal photo routes: the provider or the offline reader is busy; Retry-After carries the wait.

token_not_allowed.meaning: Access tokens cannot be used on this route (account, sign-in, admin, backup, AI, journal, workspace management, the token routes themselves). Use a signed-in session.

token_read_only.meaning: The access token is read-only and the route writes.

token_workspace.meaning: The access token is limited to one workspace and the request is not inside it: ?workspace= is missing or names another workspace, or the route spans workspaces or addresses objects by id.

study_row_unreadable.meaning: A write (POST /api/sync/push) would replace a stored typed study row this server version cannot read back: stored JSON it does not know, such as a deck source type or a new-card order written by a newer server, or a damaged row. Nothing in the request is applied and the stored row is kept unchanged; reads skip it (docs/contracts/sync/README.md, Reading rows).

sync_collection_moved.meaning: GET /api/sync/pull?v=2 named a lexicon collection (entries, links, senses, levelMembers, dictionaries, schemes, levels). Those moved to data packages: read GET /api/packages (docs/contracts/packages/).

sync_page_invalid.meaning: A paged pull (v=2) parameter is wrong: a page or since token that is malformed, belongs to another user or to other filters (collections, workspace, tombstones), a page= request that repeats since, collections, workspace, limit or tombstones, a limit outside 1-2000, a tombstones value other than 1, or an unknown collection. Start the round again without page (docs/contracts/sync/).

sync_cursor_expired.meaning: The paged pull's since cursor is older than the server keeps deletions for. Discard local user data and pull again without since (docs/contracts/sync/). Defined for a future tombstone purge.

events_page_invalid.meaning: A paged GET /api/events (limit or page given) parameter is wrong: a page token that is malformed or belongs to another user, a continuation whose workspace is not the first page's (or that repeats since or limit), an empty page, or a limit outside 1-2000. Read the log again from its first page (docs/contracts/events/).

package_not_found.meaning: No data package with that id and revision (or the id is not a package id). Re-read GET /api/packages.

package_revision_gone.meaning: That package revision was replaced and its file purged. Re-read GET /api/packages and download the current revision.

download_busy.meaning: GET /api/packages/{id}/{revision}: two package downloads of this account (sessions and tokens together) are already running. Unlike rate_limited this may be retried automatically after Retry-After (5 seconds); resume with Range.

token_limit.meaning: 20 live access tokens already; revoke one first. Expired tokens do not count.

invalid_token_request.meaning: Name (1-64 characters), scope (read or write) or expiry (1-365 days) out of range; the message names the field.

no_key.meaning: AI routes: no API key is stored for the active provider. Add one in Settings, AI.

no_selection.meaning: AI routes: no provider is chosen (several keys, none active).

provider_disabled.meaning: AI routes: the chosen provider is turned off on this server (QINQIN_AI_PROVIDERS).

ai_disabled.meaning: AI routes: QINQIN_SECRET is missing or invalid, or the server's AI provider setting is invalid; no key can be stored or used.

key_undecryptable.meaning: AI routes: the stored key was sealed with another QINQIN_SECRET and cannot be read; enter it again.

in_flight.meaning: AI routes: another AI request of this user is still running.

no_vision.meaning: POST /api/journal/photos/{id}/transcribe: the active model cannot read photos; the message names model and provider. Offer offline reading.

unknown_provider.meaning: AI routes: no provider with that id.

invalid_model.meaning: The model id is empty or not letters, digits and . _ : / @ - (at most 200 characters).

invalid_key.meaning: The API key does not look like a key (empty, spaces, too long).

invalid_endpoint.meaning: A custom AI endpoint (admin) is not valid; the message says why.

endpoint_blocked.meaning: A custom AI endpoint resolves to an address that is never allowed, or to a private one while QINQIN_AI_ALLOW_PRIVATE is off.

key_rejected.meaning: The AI provider rejected the API key.

quota.meaning: The AI provider account is out of credit or over its quota.

model_unavailable.meaning: The model is not available for this key at the provider.

no_access.meaning: The key has no access to this model or action at the provider.

truncated.meaning: The AI answer was cut off (too long).

bad_reply.meaning: The AI answer could not be parsed.

too_long.meaning: Journal review: the text is longer than 5,000 characters.

empty.meaning: Journal review or ideas: there is no text to work with.

photo_too_large.meaning: POST /api/journal/photos: the photo is larger than 10 MB.

unsupported_image.meaning: POST /api/journal/photos: not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.

image_too_large.meaning: POST /api/journal/photos: the photo has more than 25 megapixels.

conversation_full.meaning: Journal conversation partner: the conversation holds the maximum of 50 messages; save it or start a new one.

wrong_language.meaning: Journal conversation partner: the AI's reply was not (mostly) in the workspace language; nothing was stored, send again.

examples_full.meaning: AI example sentences: the word has the maximum of 10 kept AI examples; delete one first.

conversation_limit.meaning: Journal conversation partner: 20 conversations are open in the workspace already; save or discard one first.

too_many_photos.meaning: Journal photos: 10 photo drafts are open already; finish or discard one first.

ocr_unavailable.meaning: Journal photos: offline reading (OCR) is not installed on this server.

ocr_language_missing.meaning: Journal photos: offline reading has no model for the entry's language; the message names it.

ocr_failed.meaning: Journal photos: offline reading failed on this photo.

conflict.meaning: The request conflicts with the current state and no more specific code applies (for example installing a staged pack that was already installed or refused).

method_not_allowed.meaning: The API path exists but not with this method; the Allow header lists the methods it takes.

range_not_satisfiable.meaning: A download's Range header lies outside the file (package, audio clip, font slice, backup and stroke downloads).

precondition_failed.meaning: A download's If-Match or If-Unmodified-Since condition failed.

not_implemented.meaning: The route exists but this instance or source cannot do it (a library source without a browse list).

workspace_not_found.meaning: The workspace the request names does not exist (any more) or belongs to someone else. The client drops it and switches to another workspace. (Sync pull and push and token creation answer the older not_found for the same case.)

workspace_exists.meaning: A workspace with that name already exists for this user.

last_workspace.meaning: The workspace is the user's only one; keep at least one.

language_unknown.meaning: The workspace language is not registered on this server; an administrator adds it under Admin, Languages.

language_built_in.meaning: Admin languages: a built-in language cannot be removed.

language_in_use.meaning: Admin languages: workspaces or installed packs still use the language. The body carries usage, counts only (never who): {workspaces, dictionaries, levelLists, frequencyPacks, sentencePacks, grammarPacks, audioPacks, legacySentences}, each an integer (dictionaries and legacySentences 0 or 1). legacySentences: shared sentences without a registry row (imported before v0.2.0; GET /api/admin/packs does not list them); the message names each such pack with its removal route DELETE /api/admin/sentences/{pack}.

pack_invalid.meaning: The uploaded pack is not a valid pack; the message names the rule it breaks (never a server path).

pack_type_unsupported.meaning: The pack's type is unknown or cannot be installed through this route (audio packs are installed on the host).

pack_staged.meaning: A pack is already staged for review: install or discard it first.

pack_import_running.meaning: A pack import is already running on this server; try again when it has finished.

import_busy.meaning: A library import from a source is already running for this user; wait for it to finish.

book_exists.meaning: The book is already in this workspace's library.

bookmark_limit.meaning: The book already has the maximum number of bookmarks (200).

highlight_limit.meaning: The book already has the maximum number of highlights (2000).

highlight_overlap.meaning: The text is already highlighted; existingId names the highlight that covers it.

epub_unreadable.meaning: The uploaded file, or the source's file, is not a readable EPUB.

language_mismatch.meaning: The book's language is not the workspace's; workspaceLanguage and bookLanguage name both.

source_unavailable.meaning: The library source did not answer; try again later.

source_language_unavailable.meaning: The library source has no books in the workspace's language.

unknown_time_zone.meaning: PUT /api/me/time-zone: the zone is not an IANA name this server knows (study-day/time-zone-api.json).

too_many_changes.meaning: PUT /api/me/time-zone: the account has the most zone changes the history keeps (study-day/).

licence_mismatch.meaning: POST /api/admin/packs/staged/{token}: the licence sent is not exactly the staged pack's (the administrator confirms the licence the review showed).
